The main takeaway from our work is that
it is not necessary to measure the shear correlation function at many separations in order to constrain cosmological parameters from cosmic shear data.
the E/B-mode decomposition is not necessary for the purpose of E/B-mode separation in cosmic shear data analysis, and it should be replaced with a Fourier band-power approach.
the E/B-mode separation of cosmic shear data can be performed in Fourier space, rather than in configuration space, and this leads to a number of advantages.
